label: Dr. Lee — an MBA class anthem about using AI with good judgment

tracks.title: Dr. Lee
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro]
Class is in session. Dr. Lee at the board.
MBA crew, let’s get practical.

[Verse 1]
Dr. Lee walks in, marker uncapped,
AI on the syllabus, facts on the map.
Built from a prompt, but the lesson is real:
Ask better questions, then check every deal.
From market research to a forecast draft,
He shows where the model can save you a task.
But numbers need context, claims need proof,
A clean-looking answer ain’t always the truth.

[Chorus]
Dr. Lee, teach the whole room,
AI in the toolkit, make the next move.
Think it through, check what you do,
MBA minds put the smart to use.
Dr. Lee, bring the class alive,
Human judgment with the tools beside.
Learn the method, question the view,
Build better business with AI in the room.

[Verse 2]
Case study open, teams take a side,
Prompt for the options, let the evidence guide.
Draft that pitch, then revise the frame,
Protect private data, don’t paste the names.
Bias in the output? Put it on trial,
Compare with the source, take a second mile.
Lee says, “The tool can help you move fast,
But own every choice when the work is passed.”

[Chorus]
Dr. Lee, teach the whole room,
AI in the toolkit, make the next move.
Think it through, check what you do,
MBA minds put the smart to use.
Dr. Lee, bring the class alive,
Human judgment with the tools beside.
Learn the method, question the view,
Build better business with AI in the room.

[Outro]
Class dismissed—keep your standards high.
Dr. Lee, AI professor, signing off.
